cube.name: Metamorphic Cube
cube.description: An odd, gently thrumming magic box. Place items inside to transmute them into something new.
recipebook.name: Transmutation For Novices
recipebook.description: It's lighter than it looks. It never seems to have the same number of pages.
mail1.title: A Magical Cube
mail1.textcontent: @,^^I have enclosed a gift for you: a Metamorphic Cube, the last work of the great wizard Horadrus. Its magic was intended to help mundane folk; I trust that you will find it useful in your line of work.^^The Cube can transmute items into new ones, as long as you follow the recipes. Only... forgive me, but I have misplaced the book that contains them.^^When I find it, I will pass it on to you. In the meantime, why not experiment?^^-M. Rasmodius, Wizard
mail2.title: Cube Recipes
mail2.textcontent: @,^^I have located the Metamorphic Cube recipe book I mentioned previously. Please find it enclosed.^^-M. Rasmodius, Wizard
secretnote.contents.1: They all laughed... they said it couldn't be done! But no matter; transcendence will be mine at last!^^Now that I have constructed the cube, all I need are the three sacred items. The cube will take care of the rest.^^Trust the cube. Trust.
